summary: Tufts University is running a study to learn how people can keep weight off after they stop taking GLP-1 medications, which are treatments used for weight loss. The study will look at how well a digital program helps participants with weight maintenance, meaning keeping their weight stable over time. A total of 200 adults who recently stopped taking a GLP-1 medication can join this fully remote study. Participants will either use a digital program on a smart device or receive usual care without the program.
